notes.title: Rampage Agents Christmas Update Announcement (V1.3.0)
notes.notes:
Greetings, Agents!
The holiday season is here, and we’re thrilled to unveil the latest version of Rampage Agents. Check out all the exciting updates below:

 [b][h2]🎮1. Festive Christmas-Themed Lobby[/h2][/b]
🔹Immerse yourself in the winter festivities while battling in style! Let’s welcome Christmas together, Agents!

[h2][b]🎮2. New Season of Battle Royale[/b][/h2]
🔹The next season of Battle Royale begins now!
📌Season Rewards: Previous season rewards will be distributed after the update, and rank points will be reset.
📌Battle Pass: A new Battle Pass is here, offering rewards consistent with the final EA season.

[h2][b]🎮3. Private Matches & Spectator Mode[/b][/h2]
🔹Private Matches: Create custom Battle Royale games and hone your skills with friends!
🔹Spectator Mode: Experience the action like never before with VR spectator mode and a new PC spectator platform. Enjoy diverse perspectives while watching epic battles unfold!

[h2][b]🎮4. Frontier Rewards Platform Goes Live[/b][/h2]
🔹The Frontier Rewards Platform is officially here!
📌Access it through the recruiter interface. Earn Star Credits by logging in daily, inviting new players, and more.
📌Redeem Star Credits for rare items, exclusive skins, physical merchandise, and even custom-made items!

[h2][b]🎮5. First VR Esports Tournament Recruitment[/b][/h2]
🔹The inaugural Rampage Agents VR Esports Tournament is here!
📌We’re looking for 12 teams to compete. Winners will take home cash prizes and VR gear worth thousands of dollars. Sign up now and show your skills!

[h2][b]🎮6. Improved Matchmaking in Battle Royale[/b][/h2]
🔹To enhance gameplay, we’ve adjusted matchmaking in Battle Royale. New players will no longer face high-ranked opponents in solo matches.

[b][h2]🎮7. Adjustments to Mobility Mechanics[/h2][/b]
🔹For a more balanced tactical experience, we’ve adjusted certain mechanics:
📌Reduced the maximum range of grappling hooks.
📌Adjusted the sliding mechanism to better balance movement strategies.

[h2][b]🎮8. Shop Updates[/b][/h2]
📌New Holiday Items: Christmas-exclusive Lights series character skins have been added to Rampage Packs.
📌Featured Items: The sale cycle for featured items has been updated, with more diverse and exciting selections now available.

[h2][b]🎮9. Timed Rank Contest Start Time Change[/b][/h2]
🔹With the start of Season 2, the timed rank contest will now be divided into three time slots, each lasting 90 minutes.

🔹Season 2 Timed Rank Contest Schedule:
📌CET: 19:30 - 21:00, 0:30 - 2:00, 3:30 - 5:00
📌EST: 13:30 - 15:00, 18:30 - 20:00, 21:30 - 23:00
📌PST: 10:30 - 12:00, 15:30 - 17:00, 18:30 - 20:00
[h3][b]Please refer to the in-game schedule for accurate times.[/b][/h3]

[b][h2]🎮10. Agent Adjustments in Battle Royale[/h2][/b]
🔹The new season brings the following updates to agent skills:

📌Rock
- Tactical Skill – Charge Shield:
  - Increased shield size.
  - Cooldown reduced: 30s → 28s.
  - Duration increased: 3s → 4s.

📌Claire
- Passive Skill – Elemental Sense:
  - Reworked: Deal elemental damage to generate energy, and restore a shield upon leaving combat.

📌Barry
- Tactical Skill – Mirage:
  - Adjusted Effect: Most manual actions no longer cancel invisibility.
  - Cooldown reduced: 20s → 18s.
  - Invisibility duration reduced: 4s → 3s.

📌Rilla
- Passive Skill – Battlefield Rescue:
  - Adjustment: Summoned drones can now be attacked.

- Tactical Skill – Support Command:
  - Adjustment: Summoned drones can now be attacked.
  - Cooldown reduced: 45s → 30s.
  - Duration reduced: 20s → 12s.
  - Healing rate increased: 8 HP/s → 12 HP/s.

📌Fiery
- Tactical Skill – Fission Grenade:
  - Unified damage per hit: 25 points.
  - Damage required for fission reduced: 60 → 50.

[h2][b]🎮11. Weapon Adjustments in Battle Royale[/b][/h2]
🔹Slightly reduced the base attack power of certain Snipers.

[b][h2]🎮12. Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
📌Fixed an issue where opening hyperlinks in-game prevented returning to the game.
📌Resolved an issue where players could fall out of the preparation area and couldn’t return.
📌Fixed a bug causing sliding sound effects to persist after killing a sliding player.
📌Corrected localization text errors across multiple languages.
📌 Fixed an issue where Claire’s traps in Battle Royale couldn’t be destroyed.

[h2][b]🎮13. Christmas Party Event[/b][/h2]
🔹During the event, leave your genuine feedback on the Rampage Agents store page to receive the Grim Xmas Lights skin!

Challenge Activities
📌Make 5 new friends to earn 300 R Coins.
📌Refine 1,200 cores to earn 300 R Coins.
📌Gift a Rampage Pack to a friend to earn 200 R Coins.
📌Play a multiplayer adventure mode once to earn 100 R Coins.
📌Win two Battle Royale championships to earn 200 Crafting Materials.
📌Use Custom Dyes 3 times in the game to earn 200 Crafting Materials.
📌Complete the adventure mode on any difficulty once to earn 200 Crafting Materials.

[h3][b]We hope you enjoy the festivities and the exciting updates. Let’s celebrate Christmas in Rampage Agents![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Halloween Update Is Here (V1.2.0)!
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween, Agents!
We've got a jam-packed update full of exciting new features! We can't wait to hear what you think!

[h2]🎮Brand New Halloween-Themed Lobby[/h2]
Halloween has invaded the Game lobby. Let’s join in the Halloween party!

[h2]🎮New Friend Adding Methods[/h2]
In-game, Agents can now add friends by shaking hands or high-fiving. Become partners and fight together!

[h2]🎮Adventure Mode[/h2]
📌Newbie Multiplayer Mode Team Optimization
Newbie agents without DLC can join rooms created by others to adventure together.

📌Assisted Growth Rewards
When veteran agents above level 30 fight alongside rookie agents below level 30, crystal and core drop rewards will be significantly increased by 1.5 times! Experience the dual joy of growth and challenge together!

📌Training Grounds Flow Optimization & Tutorial Levels
We have optimized the training grounds flow for adventure mode and designed new tutorial levels with new background stories and battle content.

[h2]🎮Battle Royale Mode[/h2]
📌New Revive Mechanism
In Battle Royale mode, death no longer means the end! Teammates can pick up data modules from your death box to revive you at full health, turning the tide of battle and achieving a comeback!

📌Halloween-Themed Forgotten Desert Scene
On the dark Halloween night, who will be the last surviving agent? Let’s find out!

📌Matchmaking and Captain Assignment Logic
In Battle Royale mode, every agent will be assigned teammates first, greatly reducing the chances of being alone. The highest-level player in the team will be designated as the captain to lead the landing.

📌New Weapon in Battle Royale: Rhythmic Eagle
Feature: Shooting in rhythm will cause higher damage.

[h2]🎮Battle Royale Weapon Adjustments[/h2]
Most weapons' recoil while dual-wielding has been adjusted. Other adjustments are as follows:

📌The Equalizer:
Single shot damage: 8 → 5
Number of projectiles: 6 → 12

📌Flame Cracking:
Single shot damage: 12 → 6
Number of projectiles: 6 → 9

📌Unstable Lightning:
Single shot damage: 8 → 7
Number of projectiles: 5 → 10

📌Gungnir:
Single shot damage: 80 → 75
Base magazine: 5 → 6

📌Phantom:
Single shot damage: 48 → 56
Critical multiplier: 1.75 → 1.85
Magazine: 4 → 3
Damage multiplier for extended range decreased

📌Felbat:
Single shot damage: 35 → 32
Critical multiplier: 1.75 → 1.65

📌Cold Star:
Single shot damage: 16 → 15
Base magazine: 13 → 10
Charging time reduced

📌Flame Odonate:
Fire rate: 16 → 20
Base magazine: 40 → 80

📌Freezing Bubble:
Fire rate: 11.5 → 14
Magazine: 23 → 42

📌Flying Needle:
Single shot damage: 11 → 8
Wasp Venom duration: 5 seconds → 3 seconds

[h2]🎮Bug Fixes & Other Adjustments[/h2]
📌Fixed the issue where AI sometimes failed to appear in Battle Royale mode.
📌Fixed the issue where the storage device chip caused the skill cooldown to not reset.
📌Fixed the issue where the overflow chip allowed Fiery to infinitely restore shields.
📌Fixed some text errors.
📌Optimized the training grounds flow for Battle Royale mode.
📌Optimized the voice communication range in the prep area.
📌Added Grim's exclusive core in adventure mode.
📌Adjusted the values and features of Rhythmic Eagle in adventure mode.
📌Adjusted Rhythmic Eagle's exclusive traits in adventure mode.
📌Adjusted the loot refresh probability in Battle Royale mode.
📌Adjusted the drop rate of high-level supplies in air-drop pods in Battle Royale mode.

[h2]🎮Halloween Party Events[/h2]
📌Special Event
Become the recruiter for any 3 players and complete one game with the recruited agents to receive the multiplayer adventure mode DLC. (Players who already own the adventure DLC will receive a legendary pack)

📌Challenge Events
· Make 5 new friends to receive 300 R Coins.
·  Refine 1,200 cores to receive 300 R Coins.
· Gift a Rampage Pack to a friend to receive 200 R Coins.
· Play multiplayer adventure mode once to receive 100 R Coins.
· Win two Battle Royale mode championships to receive 200 crafting materials.
· Use Custom Dyes 3 times in the game to receive 200 crafting materials.
· Clear adventure mode at any difficulty once to receive 200 crafting materials.

[h2]🎮FEEDBACK[/h2]
Developing games for, and with our community, has always been our motto. That doesn't change with the release of Rampage Agents; in fact, it’s more important than ever! Help us shape the future of the Rampage Agents IP by sending your feedback, suggestions, and ideas our way! You can reach us through all our social channels, but especially:

- on Discord: https://discord.gg/2SpNA5MxYf

- through email: feedback@rampageagents.com

We hope you’ll enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it!

[h2]Happy Rampaging![/h2]

notes.title: Rampage Agents New Map "Pandora Valley" Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
 Rampage Agents was updated at 00:00 on April 29, Pacific Time. 
This update adds a new Battle Royale map, "Pandora Valley," offering an entirely new combat experience, adjusts the range and trigger time of Claire’s Elemental Trap skill, optimizes the arm length of characters, and fixes and optimizes a series of issues!

We hope you will provide us with some feedback after experiencing this update, as we will continue to make iterative improvements.
If you encounter any game abnormalities, glitches, crashes, or startup issues that prevent normal gameplay, you can post a detailed description of the problem, screenshots, or screen recordings to the Discord community, and we will check and address the issues as soon as possible.

[h3][b]📌New Battle Royale Map – "Pandora Valley"[/b][/h3]
🔹New buildings, new terrains, new resource points, new tactics—bringing a completely new experience. Invite your buddies to become the kings of the valley!

[h3][b]📌Brand New Combat Experience[/b][/h3]
🔹Players can still walk fast and run while holding a gun in a non-aiming posture with their off-hand;
Players will switch to slow walking when aiming with the off-hand holding the gun;
A speed penalty will be applied when a player is holding a gun in each hand.

[h3][b]📌Claire’s Battle Royale Skill Adjustment[/b][/h3]
🔹Adjusted in Battle Royale mode, the Elemental Trap placement delay: from 1.5s to 0.7s. Sensing range from 1.5m to 2.5m.

[h3][b]📌Optimizing Character Arm Length[/b][/h3]
🔹Adjusted the arm length of all special agents to be closer to actual player arm lengths, allowing for more impressive poses when winning in focus areas.

[h3][b]📌Adjustments to Gun Retrieval[/b][/h3]
🔹Gun retrieval positions are now at the chest and the waist on the dominant side, allowing players to conveniently pull out any firearm with the dominant hand and easily switch backup weapons during combat.

[h3][b]📌Speed Adjustment[/b][/h3]
🔹In Battle Royale, the base movement speed has been adjusted from 5m/s to 6m/s.

[h3][b]📌Optimization of Recovery Item Usage Time[/b][/h3]
🔹Syringe (Small) usage time reduced to 4 seconds.
🔹Syringe (Large) usage time reduced to 6.4 seconds.
🔹Shield Pot (Small) usage time reduced to 2.4 seconds.
🔹Shield Pot (Large) usage time reduced to 4 seconds.
🔹Full Recovery Pot usage time reduced to 8 seconds.

[h3][b]📌Multi-Platform Adaptation[/b][/h3]
🔹Quest series devices support launching via Steam VR and Oculus VR.
🔹Optimized the ray angle of the character's controller when using PICO Interconnect streaming.

[h3][b]📌Optimizations & Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
🔹Merged mission summary and match overview into one settlement interface to reduce screen transitions;
🔹Adjusted the friends list to a paginated display to solve the problem of lobby lag when having too many friends;
🔹Optimized the content and presentation method of initial settings;
🔹Optimized AI refresh logic and intervals in Battle Royale mode;
🔹Addressed the occasional issue of the character’s forearm appearing in the field of view when aiming;
🔹Fixed a bug where teammates were split into different squads;
🔹Fixed a bug where players could pass through walls;
🔹Fixed a bug where rank icons were not displayed during lobby team formation;
🔹Fixed the issue of excessively long loading times for the friends list and mission list.

notes.title: Rampage Agents Season 2 Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Rampage Agents Season 2—"Inferno"has been updated! This update includes the new Agent summoner "Rilla", a brand-new difficulty " Rampage 5★", a limited-time score competition mode, a scoring leaderboard system, a new grapple feature, a brand-new Battle Pass, Agent Chinese voiceovers, new HUD effects, and fixes and optimizations for a series of issues! We hope everyone will provide us with feedback and suggestions after experiencing this update, as we continue to iterate and optimize.
*If you encounter any game abnormalities, level blocks, crashes, inability to start, etc., that prevent normal gameplay, you can post a detailed description of the problem, screenshots, or screen recordings to the Discord community. We will check and address the issues as soon as possible.*

[h3][b]📌New Agent: "Rilla"[/b][/h3]
[b]🔹Adventure Mode[/b]
Summon Halo Drone, which can provide buffs, heal, draw fire, and also deal damage to enemies. When a teammate is down, the Halo Drone can rescue them in place of Rilla's hands—a versatile player in combat.
[b]🔹Battle Royale[/b]
[b]Passive Skill - Battlefield Rescue: [/b]Summon Halo Drone to automatically rescue fallen teammates, freeing Rilla to focus on defense.
[b]Tactical Skill - Support Command:[/b]Deploy Halo Drone to automatically heal all nearby units for a certain period of time.

[h3][b]📌New Difficulty " Rampage 5★"[/b][/h3]
A new difficulty, new agents, new combos, new tactics are waiting for you to challenge!

[h3][b]📌Limited-Time Score Competition Mode[/b][/h3]
[b]🔹Opening hours: [/b]
Pacific Time 2:00-4:00, 7:00-9:00, 12:30-14:30, 17:00-20:00
[b]🔹Mode Content:[/b] During the score competition's open hours, participate in the Battle Royale score competition to earn points, advance to higher ranks, and obtain corresponding generous rewards.
[b]🔹Rank Rewards: [/b]Exclusive cards, exclusive skins, exclusive exhausts.
[b]🔹Scoring Leaderboard: [/b]The game will display the top 20 players with the highest scores and award them special rewards.

[h3][b]📌Brand-New Battle Pass[/b][/h3]
🔹The new season pass opens a new chapter with over 100 new decorations and prizes, including: ultra-cool Evo Weapon Skins, Agent Skins, Weapon Skins, Rampage Packs, Custom All-color Dye, Agent Cards, Rank Cards, Transition Effects, a large amount of R Coins, and more.

[h3][b]📌New HUD Effects[/b][/h3]
🔹A cleaner, more diverse HUD interface allows you to immerse yourself more in combat. 
🔹You can choose in "System Menu"→"General Settings"→"Status Bar Display".

[h3][b]📌New Grapple Feature[/b][/h3]
Players can use the straight grapple and elastic grapple according to different terrains and combat situations.
[b]🔹Straight Grapple:[/b] Press the "Trigger".
[b]🔹Elastic Grapple:[/b] Press both "Grip" and "Trigger".

[h3][b]📌Claire Skill Adjustment[/b][/h3]
Battle Royale mode Claire skill: Elemental Trap.
Old: Delayed explosion after being triggered by the enemy.
New: Immediate explosion after being triggered by the enemy.

[h3][b]📌Battle Royale Weapon Adjustment[/b][/h3]
[b]🔹The Miser[/b]
New weapon in Battle Royale
Feature: Every 7 hits, the tactical skill will charge 50%.

[b]🔹Flaming Rose[/b]
Single-shot damage: 25->36
Fire rate: 3->2.4
Feature (Reworked): After using a grappling hook or tactical skill, Flaming Rose enters awakening for a period of time.

[b]🔹Twin Shooter[/b]
Becomes an airdrop weapon
Exclusive Attachments: When two bullets hit the same enemy, the next shot's critical damage is increased.

[b]🔹Vulcan[/b]
Fire rate: 8->7.8

[b]🔹Glacier[/b]
 Fire rate: 6.5->6

[b]🔹Self-Sharpening[/b]
Single-shot damage: 18->19

[b]🔹Bamboo Gatling[/b]
Single-shot damage: 19->18

[b]🔹Dragonflame[/b]
Fire rate: 13.5->13

[b]🔹Electric Arc[/b]
Base magazine: 20->19

[b]🔹Freezing Bubble[/b]
Single-shot damage: 6->7
Fire rate: 11->11.5
Base magazine: 22->23

[b]🔹Rainbow[/b]
Fire rate: 11->10
Elemental abnormal accumulation: 35->50

[b]🔹Unstable Lightning[/b]
Single-shot damage: 7->8

[b]🔹Cold Star[/b]
Base magazine: 11->13

[b]🔹Gungnir[/b]
Elemental abnormal accumulation: 80->100

[b]🔹Phantom[/b]
Elemental abnormal accumulation: 80->60

[h3][b]📌Agent Voice[/b][/h3]
Completed all Agent English and Chinese voiceovers.

[h3][b]📌Transition Tips[/b][/h3]
Added some transition tip content.

[h3][b]📌Optimization & Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
🔹Fixed a bug where the gun holding angle occasionally shifts in-game.
🔹Fixed a bug where guns could not be picked up or fired in-game.
🔹Fixed a bug where switching different game servers caused save files to be out of sync.
🔹Fixed a bug where picking up a stored energy chip after throwing it could glitch the grapple and skills.
🔹Fixed bugs related to AI.
🔹Optimized AI pathfinding algorithm in Battle Royale mode.
🔹Optimized the effect of Agent voiceovers in Battle Royale mode.
🔹Optimized the feel of certain firearms and UI display.

notes.title: Rampage Agents Regular Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Rampage Agents will undergo an update from 22:00 to 23:00 on February 3rd, Pacific Time.

This update adds English voice acting for characters in Battle Royale mode, reworks the Grapple system, introduces new features for adjusting the grip angle and offhand influence, launches a series of Chinese New Year themed featured skins, and fixes and optimizes a host of issues!
We hope that you will provide us with feedback and suggestions after experiencing this update. We will continue to iterate and optimize.

If you encounter any game abnormalities, level blocks, crashes, or issues starting the game, which prevent normal gameplay, you can post a detailed description, screenshots, or screen recordings to the Discord community or Steam forums. We will check and address the issues as soon as possible.

[b][h3]📌Battle Royale Adds Character English Voice[/h3][/b]
🔹We have added distinctive character voices for each agent in Battle Royale mode, giving you a more comprehensive information and a more interesting experience during combat.

[b][h3]📌Reworked Grapple System[/h3][/b]
🔹The new Grapple system will bring a brand-new combat experience. Transform into Spider-Man and freely perform your movements in VR!

[b][h3]📌Added Firearms Grip Angle and Offhand Influence Adjustment[/h3][/b]
🔹Added grip angle settings (see System Menu → Weapon Settings → Grip Angle Adjustment), allowing adjustment of the grip angle for each firearm at the weapon operation station.
🔹Added offhand influence (see System Menu → Weapon Settings → Offhand Influence), allowing adjustment of the control size of the secondary grip, making the gun follow your heart's desire.

[b][h3]📌Launched Chinese New Year Featured Skins[/h3][/b]
🔹To welcome the Chinese New Year, we have produced Chinese New Year special edition featured character costumes and Chinese New Year special edition firearm skins, letting you feel the strong festive atmosphere in the game.

[b][h3]📌Optimizations & Bug Fixes[/h3][/b]
🔹Fixed an issue where the footsteps of spectating players could be heard by surviving players.
🔹Fixed a data desynchronization issue when switching game servers.
🔹Fixed an issue where physical movement was not effective in-game.
🔹Fixed an issue where spectating players could trigger Claire's skill elemental traps.
🔹Fixed an issue where Sticky Grenades thrown on knockdown shields would get stuck without exploding.
🔹Optimized certain ground areas in the scene that would hinder player movement.
🔹Optimized the timing, order, and configuration of AI spawns.
🔹Other series of optimizations.

notes.title: Rampage Agents Regular Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

 Rampage Agents will be updated on [b]January 11th from 5pm - 10pm PT.[/b]

This update will significantly improve the game's framerate, comprehensively enhance the gunplay experience, and fix and optimize a series of bugs!
We hope that after experiencing this update, everyone will provide us with more feedback and suggestions, and we will continue to iterate and optimize.

If you encounter any game abnormalities, level blocks, crashes, or issues starting the game, which prevent normal gameplay, you can post a detailed description, screenshots, or screen recordings to the Discord community or Steam forums. We will check and address the issues as soon as possible.

[h3][b]📌Significantly Improved Game Framerate[/b][/h3]
🔹VR integrated devices will be able to play the game more smoothly, and there will be no noticeable stutters or delays in the game. This will allow you to fight more freely and vividly.

[h3][b]📌Comprehensive Enhancement of Gunplay[/b][/h3]
🔹The gunplay experience has been comprehensively improved, and during gun movement, there will no longer be any ghosting, lag, inertia, or other issues that affect control.
🔹Added Sensitivity settings (see Settings → Weapons → Sensitivity Settings).

[h3][b]📌New Maneuverability[/b][/h3]
🔹You can now combine Grapple and Jump to show off a variety of movements and reach higher places more easily.
🔹Adjusted Grapple length: 15m → 20m.
🔹Adjusted maximum jump height: 2m → 2.5m.

[h3][b]📌Optimized Shrink Circle Mechanism[/b][/h3]
🔹The Shrink Circle mechanism in the Battle Royale mode will be more intelligent and random, bringing more variety to each battle.

[h3][b]📌Optimizations & Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
🔹Fixed the bug where the Grapple could catapult players into the sky.
🔹Fixed the bug that allowed for the farming of Legendary Attachments from the Death Box.
🔹Fixed the bug with some of Barry's skins not becoming invisible in the Battle Royale mode.
🔹Fixed the weekly task: [BR] Deal 500 damage before the end of the first Circle Closing could not be completed.
🔹Fixed the bug that caused noise when AI attempted to rescue teammates.
🔹Fixed some bugs where Attachments and Chips were not effective.
🔹Optimized AI difficulty, reducing early-game AI difficulty and increasing it later in the game.
🔹Optimized the reward collection for the pass, now it will jump directly to the location where rewards can be collected.
🔹Optimized the loading speed of various interfaces and scenes.
🔹Other series of optimizations.

Announcing Season 1 Update Preview for Rampage Agents

Hello everyone! The first season of Rampage Agents – "POLARIS" will be updated from [b]15:00 to 17:00 Pacific Time on December 22nd. [/b]

[i]If you encounter any abnormal game behavior, such as crashes, stalls, or inability to launch, preventing you from playing normally, you can describe the issue in detail or share screenshots or screen recordings on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/h6rVhdvxsy]Discord[/url] community, and we will check and address the issues as soon as possible.[/i]
